events.title: Iran War Escalation

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war has increased the demand for defense products, which will benefit the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the conflict has disrupted oil supplies, which will negatively impact the oil services sector.

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict de-escalates or if the US and Iran reach a peace agreement

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict spreads to other countries in the region

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has held interest rates steady, despite high inflation. The decision has been met with a mixed reaction from the market, with some expecting a rate hike in the near future.
events.reasoning: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady has increased the attractiveness of the stock market, as lower interest rates make borrowing cheaper and increase consumer spending. On the other hand, the decision has negatively impacted the bond market, as higher inflation reduces the value of fixed-income assets.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the inflation rate and the Fed's future decisions
